content: प्रतन् €8 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To spread abroad, diffuse; ख्यातस्त्वं विभवैर्यशांसि कवयो दिक्षु प्रतन्वन्ति नः <ls>Bh. 3. 24</ls>. .²2 To spread, extend, stretch out. .²3 To spread over, fill. .²4 To cause, produce, create. .²5 To show, display, exhibit; तदूरीकृत्य कृतिभिर्वाचस्पत्यं प्रतायते <ls>Śi. 2. 30</ls>. .²6 To perform, do (as a sacrifice). .²7 To execute, complete, accomplish.
